title: STATEMENT OF RECORD
rule: one sentence says who he is, every clause cites a decision, and each decision corrects itself as it is read
description: A three-line statement on a forest band is the identity line; each clause cites a decision, and the fourth clause cites the store apps. Ten decisions follow as big cards. A decision with a real constraint shows it with a dotted underline; when the card reaches the reading line the constraint is struck and the result writes in after it. The band hands off to a one-line forest header whose cite lights for the current card, with a tally of corrections.
signature: Literata and one technical mono. Mint ground, one forest band with mint type on the first screen, forest pills for the current cite and id, and one accent green for the words a clause cites (no second underline). Cites hang in a 200 px margin, the same margin that holds each decision id. Plates: the care recreation at 2:1 so it ends whole inside 900 px, a 16 → 2 number plate for the billing report, one Viva Fresh store image cropped to its app screen. Motion: S3 band into header (scroll-linked, statement out over 0 to 150 px, header in over 112 to 172 px, where the band's edge meets the header's edge), S6 correction once per card (strike 260 ms word by word, stopped at the last glyph of each line, write-in 340 ms after 220 ms). Keyboard jumps and reduced motion switch state with no travel.
holdback: Lowest: original and hooks, 7/10. The frame is still a well-set report: a colour band over a column of cards, ids in a margin. The band gives the accent area but is a known hero pattern, and the 16 → 2 plate is the big-number pattern the review asked for. Open: 0004 and 0003 stay text rows with no plate (gap cut to 72 px); the write-in clip can cut a glyph at a sampled time (canon allows); the header shows the full statement only from 1320 px, below that the name and the four cites; the care chart is flatter at 2:1.
